review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–83). The two lemmas quotient_partition_refinement_left and quotient_partition_refinement_right have a similar shape: each rewrites a sum over a product, pulls a factor out of the sum, and applies the hypothesis that one family sums to 1. Each proof is only two or three lines of routine simp and rw. The two use different hypotheses, and the right lemma also needs Finset.sum_comm, so a shared helper would be a thin wrapper and would not shorten anything. The orthogonality calculation in quotient_partition_refinement is used only once in this file. quotientValue_commuting_partitions_add reuses the two lemmas through hl and hr, so it already avoids duplication. I did one grep for the Finset.product_eq_sprod/Finset.sum_product rewrite across the repository. It showed only unrelated short sum manipulations, not substantial repeated reasoning. I found no repeated nontrivial proof machinery that justifies a rewrite.
